historical_claims.anchor: The compartments in cork were the walls of dead plant cells, not tiny living chambers full of machinery.
Many familiar animal cells are ten or twenty micrometers across.
If its radius doubles, the available surface area grows fourfold, but its volume grows eightfold.
Every known cellular organism has a boundary membrane, genetic material, ribosomes, and chemical machinery that operates in an aqueous environment.
Eukaryotes include animals, plants, fungi, and many single-celled organisms that never became trees or people.
The endoplasmic reticulum helps make membrane proteins and lipids, while the Golgi system modifies and routes many molecules.
The leading explanation is that the ancestors of mitochondria were bacteria incorporated into another cell early in eukaryotic evolution.
Plastids such as chloroplasts have their own history of descent from cyanobacteria
Electron microscopy reveals much smaller structures, but it often examines prepared samples whose live dynamics are no longer occurring.

description: Explains why cell size, membranes, microscopy, compartmentalization and endosymbiosis matter to the physical organization of living cells.
